verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own vendor payment and bill-pay capability: bulk payments to vendors in 150+ countries, vendor payment-detail management, and immediate or scheduled payments arriving as soon as the same day. The evidence is framed around cross-border, multi-currency and stablecoin rails, and never explicitly names domestic ACH or domestic wire transfers; the only reference is a 'no wire fees' pricing claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic ACH payment rails, explicit domestic wire transfer support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
